entries.zh: 新模型呈现了这个分子不寻常的构象。

entries.en: We had a fab afternoon exploring the old harbour.
entries.zh: 我们探索旧港口，度过了一个极妙的下午。

entries.en: Licensed traders vend fresh fruit from small carts near the station.
entries.zh: 持牌商贩在车站附近用小推车出售新鲜水果。

entries.en: The old charter granted the burgh permission to hold a weekly market.
entries.zh: 旧特许状准许这个苏格兰自治市每周举办集市。

entries.en: Without regular cutting, the ivy will overgrow the low wall.
entries.zh: 如果不定期修剪，常春藤会长满矮墙。

entries.en: The waiter bowed politely and said, "Your table is ready, signor."
entries.zh: 侍者礼貌地鞠躬，说：“先生，您的餐桌准备好了。”

entries.en: The museum display explained how tomography creates images of hidden structures.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展陈介绍了断层摄影术如何生成内部结构的图像。

entries.en: The volunteers planted trees to restore the riparian habitat.
entries.zh: 志愿者种植树木，以恢复河岸栖息地。

entries.en: The clothier measured the customer for a new winter coat.
entries.zh: 衣商给顾客量尺寸，准备制作一件新冬大衣。

entries.en: Years of sedimentation had reduced the depth of the harbour.
entries.zh: 多年的沉积使港口水深变浅了。

entries.en: Our team must outscore its opponents in the final quarter.
entries.zh: 我们队必须在最后一节比对手得分更多。

entries.en: She labelled the last curve with a lowercase zeta.
entries.zh: 她用一个小写泽塔字母标记了最后一条曲线。

entries.en: Removing one bridge changed the connectedness of the network.
entries.zh: 移除一座桥改变了这个网络的连通性。

entries.en: The laboratory used spectroscopy to compare the two unknown samples.
entries.zh: 实验室用光谱学方法比较了两个未知样本。

entries.en: She studied abroad during the final trimester of the academic year.
entries.zh: 她在该学年三学期中的最后一学期出国学习。

entries.en: The experiment compared binocular viewing with viewing through one eye.
entries.zh: 这项实验比较了双眼观看与单眼观看。

entries.en: The neurosurgeon demonstrated the instrument to a group of trainees.
entries.zh: 神经外科医师向一组受训人员演示了这件器械。

entries.en: The diagram separates autonomic nerves from other parts of the nervous system.
entries.zh: 这幅图把自主神经与神经系统的其他部分区分开来。

entries.en: He was uncharacteristically quiet during the lively family dinner.
entries.zh: 在热闹的家庭晚餐中，他一反常态地安静。

entries.en: We plan to repaint the garden gate when the weather improves.
entries.zh: 天气转好时，我们打算给花园大门重新涂漆。

entries.en: An alum returned to the college to lead the workshop.
entries.zh: 一位校友回到学院主持了工作坊。

entries.en: The analyzer printed a graph beside the list of measurements.
entries.zh: 分析器在测量值列表旁打印了一张图。

entries.en: The engineers inspected the airframe after removing the engines.
entries.zh: 工程师拆下发动机后检查了飞机机体。

entries.en: Her econometric model used data from several regional labour markets.
entries.zh: 她的计量经济学模型使用了几个地区劳动力市场的数据。

entries.en: The researcher kept each plant clon in a separately labelled tray.
entries.zh: 研究人员将每个植物无性系放在单独贴标的托盘中。
